preconditions.expression: t == int(t) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
Each test case's first line contains exactly two integers n and k.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and k == int(k) and 2 <= k <= n <= 3 * 10**5 and k % 2 == 0 for n, k in (line.split() for line in stdin_lines[1::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, n and k are integers where 2 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 3×10^5 and k is even.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip((int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_lines[1::2]), stdin_lines[2::2]))
preconditions.description: The string s in each test case has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'0', '1', '?'} for c in s) for s in stdin_lines[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each character in s is either '0', '1', or '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
The number of output lines equals the number of test cases t.
Each output line has exactly 3 characters ('YES' or 'NO').

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == 'YES') == is_k_balanced_possible(n, k, s) for output_line, n, k, s in zip(stdout_lines, (int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_lines[1::2]), (int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin_lines[1::2]), stdin_lines[2::2]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a way to replace all '?' in s with '0' or '1' such that every substring of length k in the resulting bitstring has exactly k/2 '0's and k/2 '1's.
